title: Tor Tiv
text: The Tiv had no king. The British, who found Tivland as large as the northern emirates and hard to rule, first made a Tiv Division and a Tiv Central Council (Ijir Tamen) with its headquarters at Gboko, then in 1946 created the stool of Tor Tiv. It met a need of the colonial government, and the Tiv’s own wish for a voice in it.
